row.title: The composed organization reads the default-holds metric by default (US-16-R19)
row.body: When elicitation is switched on, the organization's tick receives the elicit module's metric functions merged under the host's own; a name the host already defines keeps the host's version. A prediction made on a held default is therefore scored without extra wiring. Proven by node --test workers/core/elicit/default-prediction.test.js.
